active_arithmetic.meaning: Input payload registers ap/bp have no reset; vp is reset. Internal arithmetic cuts select only their valid-bit reset through VB when DRST0; y/err full-data-reset branch is inactive.

inactive_file_modules.reason: Present in a supplied source file but absent from the actual 32-module closure; its p_tx_flit reset must not be treated as active q3 logic. The active replay SRAM leaf has no reset port.

other_active_reset_roles: Link control: epoch, sequence, reservation, valid, retry/abort, and fault state. Replay payload storage/capture is unreset.
ARGMAX/amerge: valid/activity/seen/group metadata; arithmetic accumulators and result payloads are unreset.
VM writer: ingress/launch-valid, bank selection/owner, used/multi and fault metadata; output payload is unreset.
Reduce: valid/pending/tag/publication metadata and pipe-valid; state payload and arithmetic DRST0 data are unreset.
Ring: valid/pending/active/read/preparation/carry-valid/fault control; state and arithmetic payload are unreset.
